(ba)༄༅/ /yang jim gyim la spring ba bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen

tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// yang jim gyim la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen te// rin chen chos kyi 'byung gnas lags// dge 'dun rin chen kun skyed pa// rin chen gsum tshogs bla mar 'dud// sku lus dal 'byor rin chen te// gsung dbyangs rin chen snyan par sgrogs// rin chen chos kyi rang bzhin thugs// rgyal bu rin chen rgyal gyur cig /lha sras rin chen jim gyim la// rin chen chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa// 'phags pa'i blo gros rin chen las// byung ba'i spring yig rin chen 'bul// khyed sku bde'am dgyes spyod dam// gsung dbyangs snyan par sgrogs lags sam// dgongs don chos bzhin grub bam ci// phrin las dge ba rgyas gyur tam// nyid dang nyid kyi yab dang ni// de yi skyabs gyur dkon mchog bcas// de dag kun gyi bka' drin gyis// bdag bde chos kyang 'chad cing mchis// slar yang nyid sku legs skyong zhing*// nyid kyis chos kyang skyong ba dang*// chos bzhin rgyal srid skyong ba yis// yab yum dag gi dgongs pa'ang skyongs// nyid kyis gus par 'dun bgyis pas// de yi 'dun pa'ang nyar 'dun pa// bdag dang bdag la 'dun pa yi// dge 'dun 'dun par bcas pa'ang skyongs// gzhan bskyangs pa yis bdag skyong zhing*// de bskyangs pa yi gnyis skyong ba// lugs 'di sems can skyong byed pa'i// dpal skyong rnams kyi skyong tshul lags// dpal gzhan bdag gir byed pa dang*// bdag dpal kun gyir byas pa yis// gnyi ga'i dpal rab rgyas 'gyur ba// nyid dpal de 'drar mdzad du gsol// gzhan dpal rnam par ma bzod pas// bdag dpal kun nas nyams gyur pa// 'di 'dra gzigs pas dpal khyod kyi// thugs rje'i dpal yang 'phel bar mdzod// chu dpal chen pos chu klung dang*// nor dpal chen pos nor dang ni// mkhyen dpal ldan pas mkhyen bya bzhin// nyid kyi dpal mkhyen de 'drar mdzod// mkhyen pas mkhyen pa 'phel gyur cing*// brtse bas brtse ba 'phel gyur nas// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i mthar son pa'i// de bzhin gshegs pa pha mthar byon// de mthar gzhal bar su yis spobs// de yi gsung gi rjes zhugs na// de 'drar de yang 'gyur ro zhes// de nyid kyis de gsal bar gsungs// 'di 'dra shes pa'i shes ldan gzhan// dpag tu med pa grol gyur na// khyed dang rnam grol brnyes bya'i phyir// brtson par rigs pa ma lags sam// blo bzang ba dang gsan mang phyir// de kun khyed kyis mkhyen mod kyi// don che ba dang der bskul phyir// brjod la nongs gang bzod par dgongs// bder bzhugs dri bar bgyi phyir dang*// bde ba'i thabs la bskul phyir dang*// 'di yi tshul yang zhu ba'i phyir// pho nya 'di dag mngags pa lags// bdag gis bzlas pas mang bgyis pa'i// tsandan dkar po'i phreng ba dang*// char skyob byed pa'i phrug dmar gsum// sa las byung ba'i sa le sbram// ro mchog ldan pa'i bu ram rnams// yi ge'i rten du 'bul ba lags// slad nas 'os pa gang rnyed pa// rim pa bzhin du bskur bar bgyi// khyed sku bde zhing sku tshe ring*// mthu stobs dpal 'byor rnam rgyas nas// mdzad spyod dge ba 'ba' zhig gis// bstan pa'i rtsa lag mdzad gyur cig
/glang lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gsum la dpal sa skyar bris/ bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
